description: Classify headlines into market-catalyst categories (earnings, merger/acquisition, buyback, dividend, guidance, restructuring, regulatory, legal, news), shaped as events with any tickers you attach. Classification only — no direction or outcome prediction. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

headlines.description: Up to 50 headlines, as strings or {headline, tickers} objects

name: catalyst_classify
